thesis: Fabrinet is the largest independent contract manufacturer of high-speed optical transceivers, coherent DCI pluggables and HPC PCBAs, built almost entirely in Thailand for customers including Cisco (20% of FY2026 revenue), NVIDIA (16%), Nokia (11%) and Amazon (11%). FY2026 revenue rose 36% to $4.64B with non-GAAP EPS up 39% to $14.09, and Q4 data-center revenue reached $669M (51% of total, +68% YoY), yet the stock sits ~45% below its 52-week high because NVIDIA has dual-sourced 800G, gross margin is stuck near 12%, and FY2026 free cash flow collapsed to $4M on doubled capex. At ~22x consensus FY2027 EPS with ~$875M net cash and no debt, the valuation prices in a stall that guidance does not support. The primary risk is that four customers are ~58% of revenue on a 12% gross margin, so any AI capex digestion hits hard.

drivers: Datacom re-accelerates as merchant transceiver makers and hyperscalers replace NVIDIA's earlier growth contribution
Building 10 at Chonburi fills quickly, lifting capacity toward $8.5-9.3B and the full footprint plan toward $12.5-14B of annualized revenue
400ZR/800ZR data-center interconnect scales well beyond the $1B annualized run rate reached at the end of FY2026
Co-packaged and near-package optics plus optical circuit switching shift mix and finally push gross margin above the 12-13% band
FY2028 non-GAAP EPS of $23-25 re-rated at ~30x as free cash flow turns positive again

base_case.assumptions: FY2027 tracks consensus of ~$18.56 non-GAAP EPS (~32% growth) on revenue building from the $1.375-1.425B Q1 guidance range, gross margin flat at 12.0-12.5%, Pillar Two tax remaining a ~$0.40/quarter drag, and free cash flow turning positive during FY2027 as the Building 10 capex wave peaks. Multiple re-rates to 26-30x forward earnings — above the current ~22x but well below the $650-734 sell-side average targets.

risks: Hyperscale AI capex digestion in calendar 2027 slows transceiver and HPC PCBA build rates
Further NVIDIA share loss plus insourcing or dual-sourcing by Cisco, Nokia or Amazon
Gross margin stays at or below 12% while depreciation from the new footprint lands on a lower revenue base
$1.02B inventory balance requires write-downs if end demand rolls over before it ships
Multiple compresses to 18-20x on flat $15-16 non-GAAP EPS

catalysts.event: Q1 FY2027 earnings (estimated date): tests guidance of $1.375-1.425B revenue and $4.10-4.25 non-GAAP EPS, plus management's claim that datacom returns to sequential growth
Q2 FY2027 earnings: December-quarter datacom trajectory and first read on Building 10 contribution
OFC 2027: Fabrinet investor sessions, CPO/NPO, 1.6T and optical circuit switching updates
Q3 FY2027 earnings: gross margin check against the 12.5% threshold and free cash flow inflection
Building 10 Chonburi ramp (~2M sq ft, ~$3.0-3.5B revenue capacity) and Santa Clara NPI facility coming online

key_risks: Customer concentration: Cisco 20%, NVIDIA 16%, Nokia 11%, Amazon 11% of FY2026 revenue (~58% in four accounts)
NVIDIA has diversified 800G transceiver supply away from Fabrinet as sole source
Structurally thin margins: 12.0% GAAP gross margin, ~10.8% non-GAAP operating margin, no pricing power over OEM customers
Free cash flow of only $4.2M in FY2026 with inventories nearly doubled to $1.02B
Capacity bet: a $12.5-14B footprint plan against $4.6B of current revenue
Manufacturing concentrated in Thailand, with China and Israel operations — flood, tariff, export-control and geopolitical exposure
OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax is a permanent effective tax rate step-up ($57.4M in FY2026, $0.40/share guided in Q1 FY2027)
Competition from Jabil, Flex, TTM Technologies, customer in-house lines and lower-cost Chinese optical module makers
High sector beta: the AI optics complex trades as a block, with FN falling on peer news it has no exposure to
